top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A propane tank was observed in an outdoor area accessible to children.

Primary Caregiver in Licensed Home Qualifications - pediatric first-aid and pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1107(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The provider does not have current pediatric first aid and pediatric CPR.

top_violation_types.title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §747.801(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The admission forms used were outdated. The admission forms do not capture the required minimum standards changes of March 2023.

top_violation_types.title: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired (26 TAC §747.3803(b))
Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The required annual training on the following topics had not been completed by  caregivers.  The  required training topics are 3. administering medication 4.preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction and 6. handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials.

top_violation_types.title: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The breezeway utilized by children to go outside had a strong cigarette odor.

top_violation_types.title: AP Never exceed capacity of the home (26 TAC §747.207(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation was observed caring for thirteen children. The capacity on the permit is 12.
